name: KorrAI
long_description:
KorrAI started in 2021 as a spin-off from a Canadian Space Agency research project. We spent four years building ground motion monitoring for mines and infrastructure, and kept running into the same problem. The engineers who sign off on a site's safety work from decades of reports, sensor readings, and surveys held by consultants, contractors, and site teams, and they assemble that record by hand.

TRAIL is our AI platform for those decisions. Mining is our focus, starting with mine closure, where legacy sites carry decades of fragmented records, and a wrong answer has regulatory and safety consequences. We are a 20-person team of geoscientists and AI engineers, and we monitor more than $100 billion in assets across 5 million sq. km.

Who we serve:

TRAIL is used by the people who manage risk on critical infrastructure. In mining, that means closure professionals, geotechnical engineers, and Engineers of Record at mining companies, engineering consultancies, and regulators. For data centers and other critical infrastructure, risk engineers and underwriters use TRAIL for site selection, feasibility, and construction risk. 

We have worked with organizations including Agnico Eagle, Hecla, Eldorado Gold Corporation, Stantec, AECOM, Ramboll, Amazon Web Services and Zurich North America.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Serial founder. Started Mycopie in my second year at NIT Karnataka and sold it, then built and sold HopCar, a consumer app. Spent the years between building enterprise IoT systems for ONGC in oil and gas, Ooredoo in telecom and Nokia in manufacturing. Co-founded KorrAI in 2020 out of a Canadian Space Agency research project and grew it to 20 people. We build AI agents for mining; our product, TRAIL, builds the safety case the Engineer of Record signs.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
My passion for knowledge and tinkering with technology quickly lead me to transition from a professional hockey career to the geosciences, where I found an absolute fascination with image sensors, spectroscopy, and working with geospatial data.

I am driven by the pursuit of commercially viable technologies and solutions for industries that are most critical to the transition to a sustainable economy. I believe in open data, collaboration, and strong digital privacy protections.
